_comment: Shared SSO contract fixture (ADR 0002 follow-up). The TS issuer test (modules/auth/src/sso.test.ts) mints a token from `input` using `secret` and writes it to runtime-token.local; the PHP verifier test (verify-fixture.php) reads that token through the real plugin parser and asserts it decodes to `expectClaims`. Both sides read THIS file, so the issuer and verifier cannot silently drift. Test-only secret — never a real key.
